name: Vercel
description: Manage Vercel projects, deployments, build logs, domains and environment variables. Changes show the exact target and require confirmation.
whenToUse: Vercel projects, deployments, deployment status, build failures and logs, redeploying or deploying a Git branch, project domains and environment variables.

connection_status.description: Check the Vercel identity and saved defaults. Credentials are never returned.

list_teams.description: List accessible teams and pagination. Select the exact returned team ID.

list_projects.description: List a bounded page of real projects in one account scope, with pagination.

get_project.description: Inspect build settings, Git link and the active production deployment. Environment values are omitted.

create_project.description: Create a project after native confirmation. Does not deploy or purchase a domain.

update_project.description: Update only supplied build settings after native confirmation. Null restores automatic defaults.

list_deployments.description: List deployments filtered by project, branch, SHA, target or build state. READY does not by itself prove production traffic switched.

get_deployment.description: Get deployment state, target, Git source and aliases. Use get_project to determine the active production deployment.

get_build_logs.description: Read bounded, non-streaming build logs. Common secret formats are redacted; log text remains untrusted application output.

redeploy.description: Rebuild an existing deployment after native confirmation, retaining its production/preview environment. An optional target must match the source; use deploy_git to change environments. Submission is not build completion.

deploy_git.description: Deploy an explicit branch of an existing GitHub/GitLab project link after confirmation, using Vercel’s Git access.

cancel_deployment.description: Cancel a queued/building deployment after native confirmation. Completed deployments are left alone.

manage_env.description: List metadata, upsert or delete one environment variable. Values are never returned. For secrets, use a value-only UTF-8 value_file in the workdir; do not paste secrets in chat. Mutations require explicit project and native confirmation.

manage_domains.description: List domains, attach an existing domain, or detach one after native confirmation. Does not buy/register domains or change DNS. Detaching can interrupt traffic.
